title: Brown representability for cohomological functors
statement: Let C be a compactly generated triangulated category [def-pc-compactly-generated] with set-indexed coproducts. Every contravariant cohomological functor H:C^{op}\to Ab [def-sp-abelian; equivalently, a homological functor on C^{op} as in def-sp-homological-functor] that sends set-indexed coproducts in C to products of abelian groups is representable: there exist an object G of C and natural isomorphisms H(c)\cong Hom_C(c,G).

proof.text: Unpack compact generation as a small family E of compact objects whose coproduct generates. Apply the Brown generator-construction theorem to E and H to get G and a natural transformation from its additive Yoneda functor to H, invertible on all shifted generators.

Apply cohomological generator detection to this map using the extracted generation hypothesis. Every component is invertible. Mathlib NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app upgrades this to an invertible natural transformation; the inverse of asIso α has the required orientation H ≅ preadditiveYoneda.obj G.
